chapters.title: Why Would I Build another Javascript Framework

step1.description:
On 15/02/2022, Ryan Carniato gave a lecture about SolidJS during a JavaScript Israel Meetup.

Abstract:
In this session we will look at SolidJS, a declarative JavaScript framework, 
with its creator Ryan Carniato. 
We will explore its origin, its unique reactive model, and how you can get started using SolidJS.
